# Thinkvistar

> Thinkvistar (legal name Thinkvistar LLP; also written "Think Vistar" or "ThinkVistar") is a senior-led software development company in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region, India.

Services: SaaS development company; mobile app development company; web application development company; headless CMS development; AI automation services; legacy application modernization; software maintenance and support services.
Founded: 2026. Address: Yashwant Gaurav Phase 1, Nalasopara West, Palghar, Maharashtra 401203, India.
Email: hello@thinkvistar.com. Phone/WhatsApp: +91 70210 67824. Website: https://thinkvistar.com/
Works with clients across India and remotely with teams in the US, UK and Europe. Aims to reply to enquiries within one business day.
Once the agreed payment is received, the bespoke source code, designs and database schemas built for a client become the client’s property; Thinkvistar keeps its pre-existing tools and libraries and licenses them to the client as part of the delivered work (see Terms).

## Services
- [SaaS Development Company in India | Thinkvistar](https://thinkvistar.com/services/saas-development/): SaaS product development from MVP to scale: multi-tenant architecture, subscription billing, dashboards and APIs. Senior engineers; you own the code.
- [Mobile App Development Company in Mumbai | Thinkvistar](https://thinkvistar.com/services/mobile-app-development/): iOS and Android app development with React Native and Flutter: customer apps, field-staff apps and companion apps, launched on both app stores.
- [Web Application Development Company | Thinkvistar](https://thinkvistar.com/services/web-application-development/): Custom web application development: customer portals, booking systems, dashboards and internal tools — fast, accessible and built on React, Next.js and Node.js.
- [Headless CMS Development & Migration | Thinkvistar](https://thinkvistar.com/services/headless-cms-development/): Headless CMS development and WordPress migration with Strapi, Sanity or Contentful and a fast Next.js front end — editor-friendly, multilingual and SEO-safe.
- [AI Automation & LLM Integration Services | Thinkvistar](https://thinkvistar.com/services/ai-automation/): AI automation for businesses: document extraction, AI assistants on your own data and workflow automation with OpenAI and Claude — with human review.
- [Legacy Application Modernization Services | Thinkvistar](https://thinkvistar.com/services/legacy-application-modernization/): Modernise legacy PHP, .NET or desktop systems in stages — stabilise, migrate data and move to a modern cloud architecture without a risky big-bang rewrite.
- [Software Maintenance & Cloud Support Services | Thinkvistar](https://thinkvistar.com/services/cloud-support-maintenance/): Software maintenance and cloud support with agreed response times: monitoring, security patching, backups, DevOps and ongoing improvements.
